mostWorthwhile.text: Making the song from an echo and memory was the most worthwhile connection: a reflected sound became a repeatable, teachable rhythm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment at the wall was a straightforward preparation, but less interesting than making or using it.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the cave's echo to become the basis for a song through remembered rhythm.

arbitrary.text: Adding stars to the animal painting followed the stated goal, but why the picture needed stars was not especially clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the community uses its new ways of sharing knowledge, especially after the link between discovery and teaching.
